vendors.notes: Operates and maintains the legacy core plus ~15 satellite apps. 60% of vendor's total revenue comes from this tenant. Historical other customers have churned, limiting the vendor's ability to invest in modernization.

penalty_exposure.driver: Public-market exposure from a major security or data incident during the modernization window.
Regulatory fines under generic data-protection frameworks if PII exposure persists past the hard deadline.
Annualized loss from data-integrity issues in the reconciliation pipeline.

narrative: The tenant runs on a legacy platform operated by a single external vendor that derives the majority of its revenue from this account. Roughly 40% of current billings are executed without a written contract, creating commercial exposure independent of technical debt. Worst-case penalty caps sum to ~$18.5M USD across reputational, privacy and data-integrity scenarios.
